张先生/张医生: Dr Zhang, Ningbo physician of a family with seven generations of scholarly medical practice; in practice for forty years
清仪堂: Qingyi Hall, Dr Zhang’s pharmacy, distinct from Hu Qingyu Hall
大姨子（假关系）: elder sister of Hu’s wife/concubine, an invented relationship told to Dr Zhang; not an actual newly established family member
连襟: men whose wives are sisters; Dr Zhang imagines marrying A’qiao and becoming Hu’s brother-in-law
何姨太: Madam He, A’qiao; she says she is thirty-two in this passage
白丁: a man without a scholarly degree in this particular contrast, not necessarily illiterate
